subject: approximating posterior with standard distributions in stan

messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: approximating posterior with standard distributions in stan
parts:
Hi,

I would like to approximate the posterior of a random effect so could use this approximation in a different stan model to generate predictive posterior. Random effect N(0,sigma) is implemented as u*sigma where u~N(0,1) so the first model gives me the estimate of sigma. I found that it is quite well approximated by gamma distribution but wonder if there is a more robust way to determine the approximation of sigma posterior.

Thanks for any advice,
Linas
